technique "MainTec0" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=3
  script "ClearSetColor=BackColor;RenderColorTarget=LightAlphaMap;Clear=Color;RenderColorTarget=LightSpecMap;Clear=Color;RenderColorTarget=SkySpecularMap;Clear=Color;Pass=GenSpecularMap;RenderColorTarget=SkyDiffuseMap;Clear=Color;Pass=GenDiffuseMap;RenderColorTarget=;RenderColorTarget1=EnvLightAlphaMap;ClearSetColor=IBLColor;Clear=Color;Pass=ImageBasedLighting;"
  cmd 0 ClearSetColor param="BackColor" value=0 text="BackColor"
  cmd 1 RenderColorTarget0 param="LightAlphaMap" value=-1 text="LightAlphaMap"
  cmd 2 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 3 RenderColorTarget0 param="LightSpecMap" value=-1 text="LightSpecMap"
  cmd 4 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 5 RenderColorTarget0 param="SkySpecularMap" value=-1 text="SkySpecularMap"
  cmd 6 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 7 Pass pass="GenSpecularMap" index=0 text="GenSpecularMap"
  cmd 8 RenderColorTarget0 param="SkyDiffuseMap" value=-1 text="SkyDiffuseMap"
  cmd 9 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 10 Pass pass="GenDiffuseMap" index=1 text="GenDiffuseMap"
  cmd 11 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 12 RenderColorTarget1 param="EnvLightAlphaMap" value=-1 text="EnvLightAlphaMap"
  cmd 13 ClearSetColor param="IBLColor" value=0 text="IBLColor"
  cmd 14 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 15 Pass pass="ImageBasedLighting" index=2 text="ImageBasedLighting"
  pass 0 "GenSpecularMap" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 1 "GenDiffuseMap" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 2 "ImageBasedLighting" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "MainTecBS0" mmdpass=object_ss usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=3
  script "ClearSetColor=BackColor;RenderColorTarget=LightAlphaMap;Clear=Color;RenderColorTarget=LightSpecMap;Clear=Color;RenderColorTarget=SkySpecularMap;Clear=Color;Pass=GenSpecularMap;RenderColorTarget=SkyDiffuseMap;Clear=Color;Pass=GenDiffuseMap;RenderColorTarget=;RenderColorTarget1=EnvLightAlphaMap;ClearSetColor=IBLColor;Clear=Color;Pass=ImageBasedLighting;"
  cmd 0 ClearSetColor param="BackColor" value=0 text="BackColor"
  cmd 1 RenderColorTarget0 param="LightAlphaMap" value=-1 text="LightAlphaMap"
  cmd 2 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 3 RenderColorTarget0 param="LightSpecMap" value=-1 text="LightSpecMap"
  cmd 4 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 5 RenderColorTarget0 param="SkySpecularMap" value=-1 text="SkySpecularMap"
  cmd 6 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 7 Pass pass="GenSpecularMap" index=0 text="GenSpecularMap"
  cmd 8 RenderColorTarget0 param="SkyDiffuseMap" value=-1 text="SkyDiffuseMap"
  cmd 9 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 10 Pass pass="GenDiffuseMap" index=1 text="GenDiffuseMap"
  cmd 11 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 12 RenderColorTarget1 param="EnvLightAlphaMap" value=-1 text="EnvLightAlphaMap"
  cmd 13 ClearSetColor param="IBLColor" value=0 text="IBLColor"
  cmd 14 Clear param="-" value=1 text="Color"
  cmd 15 Pass pass="ImageBasedLighting" index=2 text="ImageBasedLighting"
  pass 0 "GenSpecularMap" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 1 "GenDiffuseMap" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
  pass 2 "ImageBasedLighting" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "EdgeTec" mmdpass=edge usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ShadowTech" mmdpass=shadow usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
technique "ZplotTec" mmdpass=zplot usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=1 passes=0
selection subsets=2 clamped=0
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0" "MainTec0"
  select object_ss 0-1 "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0" "MainTecBS0"
  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTech"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
runs
  run "MainTec0"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "GenSpecularMap" rt0=SkySpecularMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=512x256+0+0
    draw geometry pass=1 "GenDiffuseMap" rt0=SkyDiffuseMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=512x256+0+0
    draw geometry pass=2 "ImageBasedLighting" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=3 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
  run "MainTecBS0"
    start rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    draw geometry pass=0 "GenSpecularMap" rt0=SkySpecularMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=512x256+0+0
    draw geometry pass=1 "GenDiffuseMap" rt0=SkyDiffuseMap rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=512x256+0+0
    draw geometry pass=2 "ImageBasedLighting" rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    end rt0=main rt1=none rt2=none rt3=none ds=main.depth viewport=1000x600+0+0
    result suspended=0 draws=3 hr=0x00000000 runfailed=0
